# scripts/Visual/CrispText.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/CrispText.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Projects grouped Label3D nodes (crisp_text) into sharp 2D text above Retro and below the HUD.
Preserves fonts, colours, outlines, projected size, and no_depth_test behavior; solid-world rays test occlusion.
While drawing, hides each Label3D by clearing its render layers and restores them when released.

Base: `Control`. Registered class: `none`.

### size_of

```gdscript
static func size_of(label: Label3D, camera: Camera3D, view: Vector2) -> float
```

[Source:143](../../../../../scripts/Visual/CrispText.gd#L143)

How big `label` would be on the screen in the world (the font size it
would take, in the HUD's units): its font size times its pixel size, the
height of a line in metres, over what the view spans at its depth (the
same at any depth for a fixed-size label).
